# Zandovi design elements (schema 1.0)

Field tables for `canvasData`, generated from the OpenAPI schema every service validates against. Types: `Name` = another table on this page; `a \| b` = enum or union; `T[]` = array; `T | null` = nullable. The API validates server-side and is authoritative; these tables are a guide. `unsupportedFields` lists schema-valid fields the renderer ignores.

## `CanvasDesign` (top level)

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `schemaVersion` | 1.0 | yes |  |
| `viewport` | ViewportConfig | yes |  |
| `background` | BackgroundConfig | yes |  |
| `elements` | CanvasElement[] | yes | <= 500 items |

Element types: `rectangle`, `circle`, `ellipse`, `line`, `arrow`, `star`, `polygon`, `triangle`, `curvedRectangle`, `text`, `image`, `group`, `qrcode`, `barcode`, `icon`. Elements paint in array order (last on top). Origin: `x, y` is the top-left corner for every type except `circle`, `ellipse`, `triangle`, `star`, `polygon`, where it is the centre.
